params.body:
## Why

`/docs` was the Scribe site generated by the previous developer: off brand, English boilerplate, exception traces as example responses, and stale (it named `deletedFrom` where the code reads `deleteFrom`). The owner asked to get rid of it and serve our own documentation at the same address.

## What

- **Scribe removed**: `knuckleswtf/scribe` out of `composer.json`; the lock drops scribe, `mpociot/reflection-docblock`, `parsedown/parsedown`, `shalvah/upgrader`, `symfony/var-exporter`, `symfony/yaml`; `filp/whoops` and `nunomaduro/collision` move to the dev section (they were only production through scribe). `fakerphp/faker` was only pulled in by scribe while `UserFactory` uses it, so it is now an explicit dev dependency (same v1.24.1). Deleted `.scribe/`, `config/scribe.php`, `resources/docs/`, `public/docs/`; `scribe:generate` and `SCRIBE_BASE_URL` gone from README, CLAUDE.md and `.env.example`.
- **Own docs at `/docs`** (public, no login, embed look: paper, Inter, quiet mono): `DocsController` renders markdown from the repo at request time with `Str::markdown`, shows "Laatst nagekeken" from the frontmatter, swaps the production host for the serving host, and wraps tables so they scroll in their own box (no sideways page scroll at 390px). Routes in `routes/_partials/Docs.php`.
  - `/docs` hub (`docs/integraties.md`): who needs which of the three integrations.
  - `/docs/website` (`docs/website-embed.md`, rewritten to one screen: the line, the attribute table, three bullets, one line for WordPress/Wix/Squarespace, link to the public API). `/embed/handleiding` redirects 301, route name `embed.guide` kept; the settings tab and its mailto point to the new address.
  - `/docs/api` (`docs/api/public-api.md`): written from the code: 4 endpoints, every query parameter incl. `own_first`, one example per response, leads, error table, throttle, token location, "call from your server, never from the browser".
  - `/docs/partner` (`docs/api/partner-api.md`): the Passport partner API, ported from the Scribe text and checked against the code (9 routes, `type` filter, date filters as `deleteFrom`/`deleteTo`, the create body field by field, `update` premium only, `sold`, `DELETE` that confirms but has not deleted since February 2025, basic tables, webhooks, who uses it).
- **Tests**: `DocsPagesTest` (hub links, one-line script and attributes, headings from markdown, host substitution, 301, 404, table wrapper) and `DocsMatchRoutesTest` (the endpoint tables of both API pages must equal the `api/` route collection per half, so the docs cannot drift from `routes/api.php`; `api/elixir` excluded as monitoring). `WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest` follows the guide to `/docs/website`.
- **Rules**: S2-5.22 added, S2-5.20 updated. Finding `2026-09-16-partner-api-gebruikers` (status `vastgesteld`, ernst `info`: a measured fact, nothing to fix; both words added to the findings vocabulary in `bin/rules-findings.php` and the README) records who uses the partner API on production `api_log` (six days, 10 to 16 September 2026): Hexon as the only writer for 21 garages, FlexLease as nightly reader with per-garage OAuth consent, Okasie as portal partner, four garage websites polling, the three global webhooks. Open points `partner-delete-zegt-ok` and `globale-webhooks-voor-alle-garages` for Frederik.

## Checks

`DocsPagesTest|DocsMatchRoutesTest|RulesCoverageTest|RulesIdentityTest|RulesDocsBuildTest|WebsiteEmbedSettingsTest|FrenchLeftoversTest|LanguageParityTest|RouteCacheTest|CompiledViewsTest|StylesheetSyntaxTest`: OK (35 tests, 961 assertions, 1 pre-existing incomplete). Screenshots at 1200 and 390 checked: no horizontal page scroll, code blocks and tables scroll inside their box.
params.title: Integration docs served by the app at /docs; Scribe removed
